status: post-hoc grouped generalization stress test on fixed public CTF traces

capture_path_label_audit.interpretation: This is a provenance audit, not a model score: the trace labels are assigned from collection files whose capture paths distinguish expert terminal sessions from Agent tool-call records.

protocol.outer_split: 5-fold GroupKFold by benchmark/task_id; complete task groups are held out
protocol.unseen_model_condition: For each target model, remove all of its Agent traces from training, then evaluate only held-out-task human traces and that model's Agent traces; target model identifiers are not features.
protocol.all_models_reference: Same held-out task folds and evaluation records, with all Agent models represented in training.

features.command_tfidf: TF-IDF command-name unigram and bigram features; vocabulary fit on the corresponding training partition.
features.action_tfidf: TF-IDF coarse action-category unigram and bigram features; vocabulary fit on training partition.
features.count_action_mix: log(1 + command count) plus within-trace proportions of fixed action categories.

protocol.classifier: LogisticRegression(C=1.0, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=3000); fixed threshold 0.5; no hyperparameter search.
protocol.unit: benchmark/task_id; each per-task score uses one target Agent trace and all available human traces for that task
protocol.aggregation: task-macro within each benchmark, then equal-weight macro over benchmarks; 5,000 task-cluster bootstrap resamples stratified by benchmark

interpretation_limits: This measures transfer across three benchmarked Agent model sources within one public CTF release, not transfer to real enterprise telemetry or unseen agent frameworks.
Human labels correspond to expert terminal-session captures while Agent labels correspond to structured tool-call captures; transfer results cannot isolate behavior from capture modality.
The 40 tasks are development data already used in earlier exploratory analyses; this is a stress test, not an independent confirmation set.
The source-to-label mapping is recorded as a provenance audit and is not supplied to the classifier.
Confidence intervals resample task groups conditional on the selected benchmarks and fixed predictions; they do not include retraining or benchmark-population uncertainty.
